How much safety will be lost when a very young adult who happens to be armed loses his temper and in the heat of the moment makes a decision he would never have made were it not so readily available?

I mean these things don't make the news but at campuses the sizes of these, students are already killed by other students in interpersonal conflicts on a fairly regular basis. Introducing guns into a stewing pot of already raging hormones is going to be... interesting.
